component.name: kacola
component.summary: Record, transcribe and search your meetings

description.p: kacola records both sides of a meeting — your microphone and what the other side says — and transcribes it on your computer, live. Search every meeting you have had, jump to where something was said, keep notes next to the transcript and ask questions about it.

ul.li: Local speech recognition: audio never leaves your machine
Your voice and the far end on separate tracks, far-end speakers told apart
Full-text search across meetings, with the exact moment each hit was said
Answers about a meeting with citations back to the transcript (with your own API key)
A command-line tool and a Claude skill, so your agents can look up what was decided
